The '''Ministry of Science''' or '''Minisci''' was a branch of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] government based in the [[Minisci Arcology]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==History==
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the Ministry of Science and [[Doctor/Legends|Dr.]] [[Sionver Boll/Legends|Sionver Boll]] were working on the antidote to the virus released by [[Zeta Magnus]] on the population of the planet [[Skye/Legends|Marat V]].

In the same year, it was engaged in [[Hypermatter/Legends|hypermatter]] research, and had received a grant from [[Republic Sienar Systems/Legends|Republic Sienar Systems]] to continue its studies (presumably RSS was motivated by the need to develop it for the [[Expeditionary Battle Planetoid]]). At this time, [[Paldis Doxin]] of the [[Magrody Institute of Programmable Intelligence/Legends|Magrody Institute of Programmable Intelligence]] was involved in the research.

[[Umak Leth]], a representative of the Ministry, participated in a debate on the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] regarding the [[Malevolence/Legends|mystery weapon]] that had destroyed a dozen Republic naval task forces.
